definitions.name: x2611_15512_set_polynomial
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_set_polynomial {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (P : Set α → Prop) : MvPolynomial α ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ A ∈ Finset.univ.powerset.filter (fun A : Finset α => P (↑A : Set α)),
    ∏ a ∈ A, MvPolynomial.X a
definitions.notes: The square-free generating polynomial of the subsets satisfying P. With Mathlib predicates M.IsBase, M.Indep, and M.Spanning this gives exactly B_M, I_M, and S_M. Those predicates include containment in M.E; no subsets containing ambient junk elements are counted.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference {α R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (F : MvPolynomial α R) (e f : α) : MvPolynomial α R :=
  MvPolynomial.pderiv e F * MvPolynomial.pderiv f F -
    F * MvPolynomial.pderiv e (MvPolynomial.pderiv f F)
definitions.notes: The printed Rayleigh difference, using Mathlib partial polynomial derivatives. The coefficient ring is generic so it also applies to polynomials in x with coefficients in ℝ[q].

definitions.name: x2611_15512_tutte
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_tutte {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) (q : ℝ) : MvPolynomial α ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ A ∈ M.E.toFinset.powerset,
    MvPolynomial.C ((q ^ (M.eRk (↑A : Set α)).toNat)⁻¹) *
      ∏ a ∈ A, MvPolynomial.X a
definitions.notes: Z_M(q,x) = sum over A subset E of q^(-r_M(A)) x^A. Finite matroid ranks are natural numbers; (q^rank)⁻¹ is exactly the printed negative power for q > 0. Coefficients are real and q is held fixed.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_z_rayleigh
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15512_z_rayleigh {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (e f : α), e ∈ M.E → f ∈ M.E → e ≠ f →
      ∀ (x : α → ℝ), (∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) →
        0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x
          (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_tutte M q) e f)
definitions.notes: The Z-Rayleigh property expanded as its inequalities for 0 < q ≤ 1. The defining Tutte polynomial is automatically nonzero, multiaffine, and coefficientwise positive at q > 0. Weights are required positive exactly on the matroid ground set.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_simple
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15512_simple {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Set α), A ⊆ M.E → A.encard ≤ 2 → M.Indep A
definitions.notes: Simple matroid: all ground-set subsets of size at most two are independent. This excludes both loops and parallel pairs. The installed Mathlib provides Indep and Loopless but no Matroid.Simple predicate.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_normalized_tutte
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_normalized_tutte {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) : MvPolynomial α (Polynomial ℝ) := by
  classical
  exact ∑ A ∈ M.E.toFinset.powerset,
    MvPolynomial.C ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) ^ (3 - (M.eRk (↑A : Set α)).toNat)) *
      ∏ a ∈ A, MvPolynomial.X a
definitions.notes: W_M(q,x) = sum q^(3-r_M(A)) x^A, used only under rank M = 3. q is Polynomial.X in the coefficient ring ℝ[q]; the x variables are MvPolynomial variables. This avoids restricting the polynomial identity to numeric q.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_graph_star
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_graph_star {α β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (E : Finset α) (p : α → β) : MvPolynomial α ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ v : β,
    ((∏ a ∈ E.filter (fun a => p a = v), (1 + MvPolynomial.X a)) - 1)
definitions.notes: For an endpoint map p, sum over vertices v of P_delta(v) - 1. Applied to left and right endpoint maps this is E_G and F_G. A graph is encoded by finite labeled edges and two endpoint maps into separate vertex classes.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_graph_d
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_graph_d {α L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R]
    (E : Finset α) (l : α → L) (r : α → R) : MvPolynomial α ℝ := by
  classical
  exact x2611_15512_graph_star E l * x2611_15512_graph_star E r +
    ((∏ a ∈ E, (1 + MvPolynomial.X a)) - 1) *
      ((∑ A ∈ (E.powersetCard 2).filter
          (fun A => (A.image l).card = 2 ∧ (A.image r).card = 2),
        ∏ a ∈ A, MvPolynomial.X a) - ∑ a ∈ E, MvPolynomial.X a)
definitions.notes: D_G = E_G F_G + (P_E - 1)(H_G - sigma_E). A two-edge subset is a matching exactly when its left endpoints and right endpoints are both distinct. Simplicity is a separate hypothesis in the statement.

definitions.name: x2611_15512_graph_q
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15512_graph_q {α L R : Type*}
    (E : Finset α) (l : α → L) (r : α → R) : MvPolynomial α ℝ := by
  classical
  exact MvPolynomial.C (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
    ∑ A ∈ E.powersetCard 5, ∑ z ∈ A,
      if ((A.erase z).image l).card = 2 ∧ ((A.erase z).image r).card = 2 ∧
          Xor (l z ∈ (A.erase z).image l) (r z ∈ (A.erase z).image r) then
        MvPolynomial.X z *
          ∑ B ∈ ((A.erase z).powersetCard 2).filter
              (fun B => (B.image l).card = 2 ∧ (B.image r).card = 2),
            ((∏ a ∈ B, MvPolynomial.X a) -
              ∏ a ∈ A.erase z \ B, MvPolynomial.X a) ^ 2
      else 0
definitions.notes: Equation (5). For an injective endpoint-pair map, four distinct edges with two endpoints on each side form a 4-cycle. The exclusive-or condition says that z has exactly one endpoint on that cycle, so is pendant. The inner sum enumerates the two opposite-edge matchings; their squared differences agree. The factor 1/4 therefore gives exactly the paper's factor 1/2, with each five-edge support counted once.

statements.label: Theorem 1.3
statements.name: x2611_15512_thm1_3
statements.original:
Every matroid of rank or corank at most three is $Z$ -Rayleigh.
Moreover, if $M$ is simple of rank three, then, for all distinct
 $e,f\in E(M)$ , all $0<q\leq 1$ and all $x>0$ ,

 $q^{6}(\Delta_{e,f}Z_{M})(q,x)\geq(1-q)^{2}(\Delta_{e,f}S_{M})(x)\geq(1-q)^{2}(\Delta_{e,f}B_{M})(x)\geq 0.$
statements.lean:
{α : Type*} [Fintype α] (M : Matroid α) :
  ((M.eRank ≤ 3 ∨ M.dual.eRank ≤ 3) → x2611_15512_z_rayleigh M) ∧
  (x2611_15512_simple M → M.eRank = 3 →
    ∀ (e f : α), e ∈ M.E → f ∈ M.E → e ≠ f →
      ∀ (q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
        ∀ (x : α → ℝ), (∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) →
          ((1 - q) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Spanning) e f) ≤
              q ^ 6 * MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_tutte M q) e f)) ∧
          ((1 - q) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f) ≤
              (1 - q) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Spanning) e f)) ∧
          0 ≤ (1 - q) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f))
statements.notes: Both sentences of the numbered theorem are retained, as a conjunction. Rank and corank are Mathlib eRank of M and its dual, respectively; because the ambient type is finite these are the ordinary finite ranks. The second conjunct retains simplicity, rank exactly three, distinct ground-set elements, all positive ground-set weights, and 0 < q ≤ 1. The three inequalities are written in increasing-order Lean notation. No claim of proof is made.

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_spanning {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (M : Matroid α) (d : α ≃ β) (A : Set β) :
    (M.mapEquiv d).Spanning A ↔ M.Spanning (d.symm '' A) := by

    Matroid.spanning_iff_exists_isBase_subset']

  · rintro ⟨⟨B, hB, hBA⟩, hA⟩
    refine ⟨⟨d.symm '' B, (Matroid.mapEquiv_isBase_iff).mp hB,
      Set.image_mono hBA⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa using Set.image_mono (f := d.symm) hA
  · rintro ⟨⟨B, hB, hBA⟩, hA⟩
    refine ⟨⟨d '' B, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hB
    · simpa using Set.image_mono (f := d) hBA

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_set {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (d : α ≃ β) (P : Set α → Prop) :
    MvPolynomial.rename d (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P) =
      x2611_15512_set_polynomial (fun B => P (d.symm '' B)) := by

  simp only [x2611_15512_set_polynomial, map_sum,
    Finset.powerset_univ, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv d.finsetCongr
  intro A
  by_cases h : P (↑A : Set α) <;> simp [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply, Finset.coe_map, h]

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_rayleigh {α β : Type*}
    (d : α ≃ β) (P : MvPolynomial α ℝ) (e f : α) (x : α → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (x ∘ d.symm)
      (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (MvPolynomial.rename d P) (d e) (d f)) =
    MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference P e f) := by
  simp only [x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference, MvPolynomial.pderiv_rename d.injective]
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_sub, MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
  rw [show (x ∘ d.symm) ∘ d = x from by funext a; simp]

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_simple {α β : Type*}
    (M : Matroid α) (d : α ≃ β) (h : x2611_15512_simple M) :
    x2611_15512_simple (M.mapEquiv d) := by
  intro A hA hc
  apply Matroid.mapEquiv_indep_iff.mpr
  apply h
  · simpa using Set.image_mono (f := d.symm) hA
  · simpa only [d.symm.injective.encard_image] using hc

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_tutte {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (M : Matroid α) (d : α ≃ β) (q : ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.rename d (x2611_15512_tutte M q) =
      x2611_15512_tutte (M.mapEquiv d) q := by
  classical
  simp only [x2611_15512_tutte, map_sum, map_mul, map_prod,
    MvPolynomial.rename_C, MvPolynomial.rename_X]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun A _ => A.map d.toEmbedding)
  · intro A hA
    simp only [Finset.mem_powerset] at hA ⊢
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hb
    exact Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨a, Set.mem_toFinset.mp (hA ha), rfl⟩
  · intro A hA B hB hab
    exact d.finsetCongr.injective hab
  · intro B hB
    refine ⟨B.map d.symm.toEmbedding, ?_, d.finsetCongr.apply_symm_apply B⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_powerset] at hB ⊢
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp ha
    have hb' := Set.mem_toFinset.mp (hB hb)
    exact Set.mem_toFinset.mpr (by simpa using Set.mem_image_of_mem d.symm hb')
  · intro A hA
    have hsub : (↑A : Set α) ⊆ M.E := by
      simpa using Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA
    have hr : (M.mapEquiv d).eRk (↑(A.map d.toEmbedding) : Set β) = M.eRk ↑A := by
      rw [Finset.coe_map]
      exact M.eRk_map (f := d.toEmbedding) d.toEmbedding.injective.injOn hsub
    rw [hr]
    simp

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_eval_tutte {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (M : Matroid α) (d : α ≃ β) (q : ℝ) (e f : α) (x : α → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (x ∘ d.symm)
      (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_tutte (M.mapEquiv d) q) (d e) (d f)) =
    MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_tutte M q) e f) := by
  rw [← x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_tutte M d q]
  exact x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_rayleigh d _ e f x

theorem x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_eval_set {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (d : α ≃ β) (P : Set α → Prop) (Q : Set β → Prop)
    (hPQ : ∀ B, Q B ↔ P (d.symm '' B)) (e f : α) (x : α → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (x ∘ d.symm)
      (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial Q) (d e) (d f)) =
    MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P) e f) := by
  have heq : MvPolynomial.rename d (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P) =
      x2611_15512_set_polynomial Q := by
    rw [x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_set]
    congr 1
    funext B
    exact propext (hPQ B).symm
  rw [← heq]
  exact x2611_15512_thm1_3_eqv_aux_rayleigh d _ e f x
